target.title: fix: clean up codex run-attempt on post-registration failure
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a Codex app-server turn could start successfully and then leak the active run registration if post-start user-message persistence setup threw synchronously. In that failure window, the shared-client cleanup handlers were skipped and the run stayed registered until process cleanup.

Closes #99271

## Why This Change Was Made

The post-registration setup now lives inside the same guarded teardown path as the rest of the attempt so any synchronous exception after `setActiveEmbeddedRun` still unwinds through the shared cleanup logic. This keeps the cleanup behavior single-path and avoids leaving a phantom active run behind.

## User Impact

Codex turns that fail immediately after start now clean up correctly instead of leaving the session stuck or the shared client handlers orphaned. Normal successful turns and the existing cleanup path are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.cleanup-window.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt-thread-cleanup.test.ts`
- `pnpm build`
- `pnpm check` in a clean detached worktree at `/Users/wuqingxuan/openclaw-verify2` on commit `5215c8030`

## Real Behavior Proof

- Behavior addressed: synchronous throw from `createCodexAppServerUserMessagePersistenceNotifier` after `setActiveEmbeddedRun`
- Environment: macOS local checkout, focused Vitest harness
- Current-main contrast: before the patch, the active run stayed registered and the shared-client cleanup callbacks did not run; after the patch, the cleanup window covers that failure and the run unwinds normally
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.cleanup-window.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt-thread-cleanup.test.ts`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm check` in `/Users/wuqingxuan/openclaw-verify2`
- Evidence after fix: the new regression test passes, the existing thread-cleanup test still passes, `pnpm build` passes, and full `pnpm check` passes in a clean detached worktree
- Evidence artifact links: none
- Control check: `extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt-thread-cleanup.test.ts` still verifies the normal cleanup path
- Observed result after fix: the run no longer leaks the active registration on this failure path
- What was not tested: remote/live Gateway behavior was not needed for this local cleanup-path regression; the failure mode is fully covered by the focused local Vitest repro

## AI Disclosure

This patch was prepared with AI assistance and reviewed with focused automated tests and commit review.
